text: Fs2CommandExecutor now classifies spawn IOExceptions: NoSuchFileException -> ExecutableMissing, AccessDeniedException -> PermissionDenied, plus conservative Locale.ROOT errno-message recognition for missing file, permission denied, not a directory, and resource exhaustion. Unrecognized IOExceptions stay Unknown with bounded evidence. Evidence: two new Fs2CommandExecutorSuite tests -- a configured path that does not exist yields ExecutableMissing, and a 0600 script yields PermissionDenied. Both would have returned Unknown before. 7/7.
